svg.text: used by no wire. In v0.1 it can't be: wb:from must be a pad,
and from is always the first bond, which here is on the land.
5 · How a wire gets its shape
1 wb:profile on the wire picks the moves.
2 The wire's two endpoints give the span.
3 The die top in the stack gives the drop to the land.
4 Walk the moves, then run straight to the second bond.
